body.p: Old man. There lived an old man. The old man had three daughters. One day, winter came. The snow fell, it became cold. The old man began to freeze in his tent. The old man called his elder daughter and said: "Well, go look for a warm tent. I am cold and you are cold in our tent. Go straight along the road. You will reach a large lake. By the lake, untie the straps of your boots, go like this. Then you will see a big hill ahead. You will reach the hill. Stop near the hill. Dogs will come to you there. Don't drive the dogs away. They will lead you to a warm tent." The elder daughter put on her clothes and went. She reached the lake going along the road. By the lake, she untied the straps of her boots. She saw a big hill ahead. She went to the hill. A wind blew, it became cold. She thought to herself: "Why would I freeze? Let me tie the straps of my boots, it will be warm." She tied the straps of her boots and went. After a while, the old man's elder daughter reached the hill. The hill is very big. She looks, dogs are running toward her. The dogs wanted to lift her onto the hill. The woman said: "Go away, I will climb up myself." The dogs ran away. The old man's daughter went up the mountain herself. She reached the tent, entered the tent. There is no one in the tent. She saw the bedding, sat down on the bedding. She is sitting and waiting. Evening came. She listens, someone approached the tent, she hears, he took off his skis. After a while someone came in, she saw it was a man. The man looked at the old man's daughter and said nothing. He began to boil his cauldron. The old man's daughter is still sitting and watching. When the cauldron was cooked, the man took the meat out of the cauldron, put it in a cup and said: âThere are more tents nearby. Take the meat there." The old man's daughter took the cup and went outside. It's very dark outside. The old man's daughter went around for a while, she couldn't find the tent. She thought in her mind: âHow long will I look for this tent? There is no tent, probably the man cheated me. Let me eat the meat myself."[ShA:] 1DU instead of 1SG is unexpected. The old man's daughter ate the meat and came to the tent. The man in the tent was already asleep. The old man's daughter also went to sleep. In the morning she woke up, the man was sitting and eating. The man asked her: âDid you bring the meat to another tent?â. The old man's daughter said: "I have brought it."[ShA:] The form tÉÊiduÉ is not clear so far; maybe tÉÊiduÊÉ from a lemma that is absent eslewhere. Then the man said: "I'll go hunting now, and you sew a blanket for me without a single seam." The man left. After he left, the old man's daughter took some resin and began to glue the blanket. She glues, glues, but the blanket is torn by itself. She hears, someone entered the tent. She looked, a gray-haired old woman entered. The old woman said: âYou girl, look for lice in my head.â. The old man's daughter replied: âI myself have a lot of work. Get away from me." The old woman left. Evening came. In the evening, the man came from hunting. The man asked: âYou girl, have you sewn the blanket?â. The man took the blanket into his hands, but the blanket is torn by itself. The man said: "You're a bad girl. You have deceived me, you didnât sew the blanket, and yesterday you ate the meat yourself, you didnât bring it to the neighbouring tent.â. The man kicked this girl outside. The old man's daughter froze and did not come home. The old man was waiting for his elder daughter, but she did not come. He got frozen even more. He called his middle daughter. He said: âGo look for a warm tent. In our tent, I got frozen and you got frozen. Go along the road. You will reach a large lake. By the lake, untie the straps of your boots, go like this. You will reach a hill. Stop near the hill. Dogs will run towards you. The dogs will start to lift you up the mountain. Don't chase the dogs away from you. They will bring you to a warm tent. Now go!â. The old man's middle daughter put on her clothes and left. She came to a lake along the way. Near the lake, she untied the straps of her boots, and put the boots down. A large hill appeared ahead. She went to the hill. The wind started blowing, it became cold. The middle daughter of the old man thinks : âWhy should I freeze? Let me tie the straps of my boots, it will be warm. She tied the straps of her boots and went again. After a while, she reached the hill. The hill is big and high. She sees dogs running towards her. The dogs want to take her up the hill. The old man's daughter cried: "Go away, I'll climb the mountain myself." The dogs ran away from her. The old man's daughter went on her own. She walked for a long time, then she saw a tent. She reached the tent. She entered the tent. There is no one in the tent. She sat down on the bedding. She is sitting and waiting. Evening came. She hears that someone approached the tent, he took off his skis. A man entered the tent. The man looked at the old man's daughter and said nothing. He started cooking meat. The old man's daughter is still sitting and watching. The man is silent. When the cauldron was ready, the man took out a piece of meat from the cauldron, put it in a cup and said: âThere are more tents near my tent. Take this meat there." The daughter of the old man went out of the tent. It's cold and dark outside. The old man's daughter walks and walks, but cannot find the tent. She thinks to herself: âHow long will I walk like this? There are no tents! I'll eat this meat myself, then I'll go back to the tent." She ate the meat and entered [ShA:] Both 1DU and 3SG look strange and are unexpected.the tent. The man in the tent was asleep. The old man's daughter also went to sleep. Morning came. The old man's daughter woke up, the man is sitting and eating. The man asked: "Did you bring the meat?" The old man's daughter said: "I brought it." Then the man said: "I'll go hunting now, and you sew a blanket for me without a single seam." The man left. When the man left, the old man's daughter took glue and began to glue the blanket. This blanket tears itself. She hears someone has entered the tent. She looks, an old woman entered the tent. The old woman said: âYou girl, look for lice in my head!â. The old man's daughter said: "I have a lot of my own work, there is no time to look in your head, get out of here." The old woman left. Evening came. In the evening the man came after hunting. The man asked: "Have you sewn the blanket?" The girl replied: "I have sewn." The man took the blanket into his hands, and it crumbled away. The man said: âYou are a bad girl. You cheated me, you didnât sew a blanket, you ate the meat yourself yesterday. Get out of my tent!â. The man drove the girl out of his tent outside. The old man's daughter walked around in the tundra for a long time, got frozen, and did not come home. The old man stopped waiting for his middle daughter. The old man got completely frozen. He called his younger daughter and said: âI'm cold, go look for a warm tent. We will freeze in our tent. You go down the road. You will reach a big lake. Near the lake, untie the straps of your boots, take off the boots and go further. Ahead you will see a big hill. You will reach the hill. Stop near the hill. Dogs will run up to you. The dogs will start to lift you up the mountain. You don't chase the dogs away. They will lead you to a warm tent. So, you go! Don't forget my words." The younger daughter of the old man put on her clothes and left. She reached a lake along the road. Near the lake, she untied the straps of her boots, and took the boots off. A large hill is visible ahead. She went to the hill. A strong wind started, and a blizzard began. It is cold. The old man's younger daughter's feet got frozen. She thinks to herself: âItâs okay, I wonât get frozen, after all my father said: Donât forget my words." After a while the old man's daughter reached the hill. The hill is big and high. She looked and saw dogs running towards her. The old man's daughter caressed the dogs with her hand. The dogs quickly carried her up the hill. On the hill, she saw a tent. She reached the tent. She entered the tent. There is no one in the tent. She sat down and started waiting. Evening came. She hears, someone approached the tent, she hears, he took off his skis. A man entered the tent. The man looked at the old man's daughter and said nothing. The man began to boil a cauldron. When the cauldron was cooked, the man took out the meat from there, put it in a cup, and said: âTake this meat to the neighbouring tent.â. The old man's daughter took the meat and went out. It's cold and dark outside. For a very long time, the daughter of the old man was looking for the tent and could not find it. Then she saw a hole. She looked into the hole and saw people sitting in the hole. She thought to herself: "Let me put the cup down there." The people quickly grabbed the cup with meat. They began to eat. They ate the meat and gave the cup back to the old man's daughter. The old man's daughter took the cup, looked into it, and saw that there was a small golden lasso in that cup. The old man's daughter came to the tent and gave the cup with the lasso to the man. The man said: "Take this lasso." The night has come. In the morning the man got up and said: âI will go hunting, and you sew a blanket for me without seams.â. The man left. The younger daughter of the old man thinks: âHow can I sew a blanket without seams?â. Suddenly, someone entered the tent. She looks, it's an old woman. The old woman is very old, with a gray head. The old woman said: "You girl, look for lice in my head." The old man's younger daughter said: "Sit down, grandma." The old woman sat down. The old man's daughter began to look in her head. Suddenly she looked into one ear of the old woman: there are many people there. People are all working. Some of them are scraping the skins, others are sewing. The girl thinks to herself: âThere are so many people, and Iâm alone, how can I sew a blanket without seams?â. As soon as she thought this to herself, the old woman said: "It's enough." Getting to her feet, the old man's daughter looked down, a blanket was lying next to her. The blanket has no single seam. The old woman gave this blanket to the old man's daughter and said: "You girl, take this blanket, you looked well in my head." The old woman went out of the tent. Evening came. The man came home. He asked: âYou girl, have you sewn the blanket?â. The girl gave him the blanket. The man took the blanket. The blanket was good. He said: "You are a good girl, live with me!". The man took the younger daughter of the old man as his wife. The girl took the small golden lasso and went outside. She threw the lasso. A large herd of reindeer appeared near the tent. Then the old man's daughter brought her father to the warm tent. The three of them began to live well together.
